## Details

### ems-machinedrum-firmware

Custom Machinedrum OS (independent track lengths/speeds, trig conditions, microtiming, 128 kits, many MDX-derived fixes), patched in the browser from your OS file. Patcher only, no source. Licence: unspecified; distribution: patch-your-own. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### fsdsp56k

F# toolchain for DSP56300 machines: prototype and render on an emulated DSP, pack as MDS packages for MDX X.20. Licence: AGPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Gearmulator MD/MM

Plug-in and standalone emulation of Machinedrum and Monomachine (Gearmulator fork) booting your own OS file. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### Kitbasher

Browser tool adding extra sound models next to the stock machines of a Machinedrum OS you load (1.63, X.14, 26A09 beta, MDX X.20 B). Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later; distribution: browser-installer. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### machinedrum-kit

RE docs for Machinedrum OS 1.63 with a Python toolkit, headless emulator and example DSP machines to build into your own image. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDMM (Machinedrum and Monomachine Editors)

Desktop editors for Machinedrum and Monomachine that run the unit's own OS in an emulator (app or VST3/AU), optional hardware MIDI mode. Licence: GPL-3.0-only; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDS (Machine Dump Standard)

Machine Dump Standard: spec, example DSP machines and Python packers for custom machines in the USR slots of MDX 2.0. Licence: unspecified; distribution: source-only. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MDX

Extended Machinedrum OS (bigger sequencer, new machines, MIDI additions), shipped as ready-made SysEx. Binary only. Licence: unspecified; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### murdenihcam USR machines

Four user-machine families for MDX X.20 B: slicer, time stretcher, granulator, modulation effect. Licence: unspecified; distribution: download. Listed by altstrument; repo not read by us yet.

_Sources: altstrument (2026-11-01)_

### MoDule (MD Drums)

The Machinedrum's synthesis engines as a VST3 instrument edited like Overbridge. GPL. Found by GitHub search 2026-11-02; README start read.

_Related: builds on `gearmulator-md-mm` (README: MD Drums came from gearmulator-md-mm) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### C7

Desktop app controlling the Machinedrum and Monomachine over SysEx/MIDI (kits, sounds, patterns, songs, samples) with a DAW bridge plug-in for automation. GPL-3.0.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### ModuleDrum

Chip-level Machinedrum emulation as a DAW plug-in that runs the user's own OS and DSP programs, with the sequencer and a library. Fork of Monomodule and still builds the Monomodule plug-ins. AGPL-3.0.

_Related: fork of `monomodule` (README) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Machinemodule for MPC OS

The Machinedrum's own DSP code and machine/LFO/mixer maths as a VST2 for Akai MPC/Force standalone devices (all 16 tracks in one instance). The same author ports it to Ableton Move (Schwung) and ships Monomodule for MPC OS. User supplies the OS file. AGPL-3.0.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### MachineModule (desktop)

Windows/macOS standalone and VST3 port of sd88me's Machinedrum engine with a JUCE interface; 0.4.6 adds a native ARM JIT for voices and master effects. AGPL-3.0.

_Related: port of `machinemodule-mpc` (README) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### mdkit

The Machinedrum's EFM, TRX and P-I voice families as standalone C99 for porting, with a web demo. Whether it was derived from the OS or modelled from recordings is not said in the README start. CC0.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### OP-XY MNMD

Machinedrum and Monomachine engines written from scratch (not an emulation of the chips) for the Teenage Engineering OP-XY on the Open-XY SDK. MIT.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### BSP Machinedrum

Uses an Arturia BeatStep Pro as a front panel for the Gearmulator Machinedrum/Monomachine plug-ins, talking to the plug-ins through their MCP servers. MIT.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Machinedrum USR machines (RASP, KOOK, SMSH...)

Custom USR machines, each a single SysEx file sent to MDX's machine manager. MIT.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### Maschine MD-MM

Fork of gearmulator-md-mm with Native Instruments Maschine MK3 integration. GPL-3.0.

_Related: fork of `gearmulator-md-mm` (README) - see [PROJECT-FAMILIES.md](../PROJECT-FAMILIES.md)_

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### MDDT (Machinedrum Data Tool)

Browser tool (WebMIDI) for Machinedrum MK1/MK2/UW data over SysEx. Apache-2.0.

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_

### TurboMIDI (C++)

Header-only C++ implementation of Elektron's TurboMIDI speed negotiation (up to 20x DIN MIDI speed).

_Sources: GitHub search 2026-11-02, README_
